svg.title: Tech stack
svg.desc: Cloud & IaC: AWS, Terraform, Terragrunt, Proxmox, cloud-init, Tailscale; AWS: EC2, S3, Lambda, IAM, EMR, Kinesis, SSM; Containers & CI/CD: Kubernetes (k3s), Docker, Argo CD, Atlantis, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps; Observability: CloudWatch, Prometheus, Grafana, PagerDuty; Data: SQL, Redshift, RDS, Hive, MySQL, MongoDB, Apache Airflow, SQLite; Languages: Python, Bash, TypeScript, JavaScript, Nix; AI & apps: FastAPI, React, PyTorch, LoRA (PEFT), sentence-transformers, ChromaDB, Ollama
